ideas.quantumRationale: ERC-721 tokens provide provenance for sequential episode content.

ideas.title: Verse Vault
ideas.pitch: publish spoken word performances as voice assets to certify creator and preserve provenance.
ideas.quantumRationale: Realtime scribe is the right primitive for spoken word poetry: the user speaks the work into existence and Writing, Poetry & Narrative needs the captions to land as the words land.
